name: Advanced Queue Runner
description: Runs Advanced Queue jobs continuously in the background as a daemon, without a cron job or a manual Drush command.
project_description: Advanced Queue Runner assists the Advanced Queue (advancedqueue) module by processing its queued jobs automatically as a long-running background daemon, so queued work is picked up without configuring a cron job or manually invoking a Drush command. An admin configures and starts/stops the runner from a settings form at /admin/config/advancedqueue/runner: it records the site's Drush binary path and Drupal root path, the queue(s) to watch, a polling interval, and a per-queue (or system-wide) concurrency limit, then spawns a detached PHP process (src/Scripts/jobs.php). That process boots the Drupal kernel and uses ReactPHP's event loop to poll the selected queues on the interval, launching `drush advancedqueue:queue:process <queue>` child processes when jobs are pending. An optional hook_cron() step restarts the daemon if it is found to be no longer running (e.g. after a server reboot). Requires the Advanced Queue module and the ReactPHP event-loop and child-process libraries.
